author: Orual
message:
feat(preview): add reusable GitHub composite action for hw-preview

Composite action that other hardware repos can reference to render
KiCad designs and post previews to Plane issues. Handles Python setup,
optional kicad-cli installation via PPA, and sparse checkout of the
plane-hw-preview tool.

author: Orual
message: feat(preview): resolve issue identifiers, use image-component tags Add resolve_issue_identifier() to convert human identifiers (TEST-8) to UUIDs via the work-items search API. Switch comment HTML from raw to Plane's for inline rendering. Upload assets as COMMENT_DESCRIPTION to avoid cluttering the attachment list. Update all tests for the new comment format and identifier resolution flow.

author: Orual
message:
fix(preview): PCB renderer produces front/back composites and per-layer SVGs

The old default rendered all PCB layers into a single opaque SVG, making
multi-layer boards unreadable. Now generates three render passes: front
composite (F.Cu + silkscreen + edge cuts), back composite, and individual
copper layers via --mode-multi. Non-existent inner layers are silently
skipped by kicad-cli.

Also changes the renderer to run all matching configs per file instead of
first-match-wins, enabling the multi-pass approach.
